name: Emma Fourreau - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT containing a motion for a non-legislative resolution on the proposal for a Council decision on the conclusion, on behalf of the European Union, of the Implementing Protocol (2025-2030) to the Sustainable Fisheries Partnership Agreement between the European Union and the Government of Greenland and the Government of Denmark
part_text:
The European Parliament gives its opinion on a new six-year deal letting European Union boats fish in Greenland's waters until 2030. The European Union pays Greenland about 17.3 million euros a year, part of it for access and part to support Greenland's own fisheries policy. The Parliament says yes, but asks for better scientific data on fish stocks, protection of the seabed, and more support for Greenland's small coastal fishing communities.

- **What changes:** A new fishing access deal with Greenland runs from 2025 to 2030, with higher payments.
- **Who it affects:** Around 10 European Union boats, Greenland's fishing economy, and coastal communities.
- **What happens next:** The Parliament's opinion goes to the Council, Commission and governments before the deal is concluded.
